place: Satpura National Park and Denwa River
text:
Satpura Tiger Reserve is a tiger reserve located in the Narmadapuram district of Madhya Pradesh in India. Its name is derived from the Satpura range. It covers a total area of 2,133.31 km2 (823.68 sq mi), comprising a 1,339.26 km2 (517.09 sq mi) core zone and a 794.04 km2 (306.58 sq mi) buffer zone, in the central Indian highlands. It was declared a tiger reserve in 2000. It is rich in plants and wild animals.

Narmadapuram (नर्मदापुरम Narmadāpuram), formerly Hoshangabad, is a city in the Narmada Valley of Madhya Pradesh, along the Narmada River.
